_note: Human verification of the SEGMENTATION MASK for every photo whose measurements may enter a prior. EXP_0018: SAM returns confidently wrong objects (a back pocket at score 0.906, a wall above the garment at 0.992) and no automatic check we tried separates them from correct masks — area, contour compactness, denim colour, fabric texture and leg topology all fail on at least one real photo. At this dataset size the honest gate is a person looking at the overlay. Each entry records what was seen, not just a verdict.
_method: render the coarse mask over the photo, look at it, record the verdict. Regenerate sheets with tools/mask_sheet.py.
